capabilities: Create element notes with a type's full field set
Save, upload and download elements against onlyworlds.com
Link elements through wikilink link fields
Draw relationship canvases and write Bases files
Export and import OnlyWorlds folders as JSON
extras: Local-only worlds work with no account and send nothing; the Bases file needs Obsidian 1.9 or later; the README advises running the format commands on a vault copy first; maintained by an AI agent for Titus under MIT.
problem: Worldbuilding data held on a website or in loose notes cannot be edited as linked Markdown notes with properties, backlinks and graph links inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Atlas, which opens the same world as a folder

requires.name: OnlyWorlds world key or account token

summary: Keeps an OnlyWorlds worldbuilding world as one Markdown note per element in the vault, with optional two-way sync to onlyworlds.com.
